text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: elevated error rate + retention exception reported for Veridian Systems (VPC: veridian-prod). Root logged at 1901234567. Suspected PII in recent stderr logs. Please respond in-thread.

oncall-amber: I'm on it. Confirming scope with ops.

eng-ops-liam: seeing spikes in our dedicated pool for veridian-prod around 09:02 UTC. Lots of 500s from log-shipper process. Example log (sanitized):

```
2026-03-15T09:01:58Z ERROR log-shipper Worker-12 failed to upload chunk id=abc123 size=18KB user_id=7701 email=redacted@example.com trace_id=tx-9a7
```

eng-ops-liam: customer says their logs include unredacted PII due to a misconfigured agent. They requested we retrieve a 2-hour window for debugging.

csm-ryan: FYI Veridian's legal team (veridian-legal@veridian.com) is asking for a temporary copy for their internal review. They've opened an access request via support ticket VER-4321.

security-ops-maya: do not hand off raw logs to customer-facing channels. We need legal sign-off and a retention exception. Tagging @legal-jordan.

legal-jordan: seeing the ticket now. We need: 1) exact time window, 2) justification for retrieval, 3) who will have access, 4) how long copies will be retained. We can approve a scoped, time-limited exception if controls are strong.

veridian-sys-admin: we only need 09:00-11:00 UTC. This is for a specific debugging effort to reproduce an integration failure. Access will be internal Veridian devs only (list provided in ticket).

oncall-amber: plan proposal: 1) stop shipping new logs from the misconfigured agent to central buckets (toggle on veridian agent) 2) snapshot the affected bucket into a legal-hold partition with restricted ACLs 3) run redaction pass to remove email/ssn patterns, generate a redaction report, 4) provide redacted snapshot to Veridian under our data transfer agreement, 5) schedule retention exception to auto-expire in 7 days and then purge.

infra-nina: I can create a short-lived role and s3 path: s3://redwood-hold/veridian/1901234567-window. Will apply server-side encryption + audit logs and disable listing for everyone except the PID in the exception request.

security-ops-maya: redaction regex we propose (informal):

```
/email:\s*[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+/i
/ssn:\s*\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}/
```

security-ops-maya: note: regex redaction is best-effort. For legal purposes we need a manual review sample and a redaction audit.

eng-ops-liam: quick mitigation: disable agent upload (command):

```
# on veridian agent manager
systemctl stop veridian-log-shipper
veridian-agentctl set upload.enabled false --env=prod
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job veridian-agent-disable started by infra-nina at 09:10 UTC. Build: 2026.3.15-855.

prod-plant: I'm running a grep to find unredacted patterns in the window. Example hits: 12 emails, 1 SSN pattern (possible false positive). Will attach counts to the ticket.

csm-ryan: Talking to Veridian's security lead on the call now. They accept redaction + temporary access with legal guardrails. They also asked whether a retention exception will be visible in their console — we should not expose internal retention metadata.

legal-jordan: Approved in principle with conditions: hashed access log, list of reviewers, no external downloads, retention TTL 7 days, and notification to our privacy officer. I need a signed Exception Authorization form (I can DM the template).

veridian-sys-admin: we can sign. They want to confirm that no developer outside the listed Veridian IDs will see original PII.

security-ops-maya: action items (I'll own):
- Create scoped snapshot (infra-nina)
- Run automated redaction + generate redaction-report.csv (prod-plant)
- Manual sample review (security-ops-maya + legal-jordan)
- Grant temporary role and access (infra-nina)
- Document exception and expire policy (legal-jordan)

oncall-amber: handoff note: I'm going offline at 10:30 UTC. @eng-ops-liam will be primary after that. Please escalate to @legal-jordan if any unexpected PII surfaced.

oncall-amber: tagging incident timeline in the ticket: root=1901234567, window=09:00-11:00 UTC, snapshot path s3://redwood-hold/veridian/1901234567-window (pending).

eng-ops-liam: updating support ticket VER-4321 with snapshot plan and estimated time-to-complete ~45m.

prod-plant: redaction run in progress. Sample output (sanitized):

```
orig: user_email=alice@example.com -> redacted: user_email=[REDACTED_EMAIL]
orig: ssn=123-45-6789 -> redacted: ssn=[REDACTED_SSN]
```

prod-plant: current counts: emails=12, ssn-like=1, other identifiers=3. Full report attached to VER-4321.

deploy-bot: Deploy job veridian-agent-disable succeeded at 09:14 UTC.

infra-nina: snapshot created with encryption, ACLs set. IAM role arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/veridian-legal-access-1901234567 created with expiry 2026-03-22T09:14:00Z.

security-ops-maya: performed manual sample review with legal-jordan. All PII instances validated and redacted. Legal signed exception form (scanned copy attached in ticket).

legal-jordan: exception approved and signed. Conditions logged in internal compliance system under EXC-2026-77.

csm-ryan: Veridian confirms receipt of redacted snapshot and have onboarded reviewers into the temporary role. They asked for confirmation that logs will be purged on 2026-03-22.

eng-ops-liam: schedule set: 2026-03-22 09:15 UTC purge job will run to delete s3://redwood-hold/veridian/1901234567-window. Will keep an audit trail.

prod-plant: closing note: no further unredacted PII found outside the snapshot window. Agents updated to prevent future leakage.

oncall-amber: final handoff log: 09:02 incident reported -> 09:10 mitigation plan -> 09:14 agent disabled + snapshot -> 09:45 redaction complete -> 10:00 legal sign-off -> 10:20 access granted -> 10:30 handoff to eng-ops-liam.

eng-ops-liam: I will monitor for 2 more hours and follow up if anything else crops up. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread 1901234567 marked resolved for paging. Closure tags: customer-impact, pii-redaction, retention-exception, veridian-prod.
